summary: Siskiyou NF lookout east of Gold Beach, Curry County: 1934 L-4 cab, staffed 105 days in 1941, abandoned 1942 per one source, removal undated.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com gives abandonment in 1942. Forest Lookouts gives removal with no date. These are not contradictory: abandonment and removal may have been different events. The story reports both.

sources.title: Game Lake Peak Fire Lookout Cabin

notes_for_editor: Only two detailed sources, both thin on post-1941 history. No source describes what remains on the ground or whether the site is accessible. Forest Lookouts gives the 1941 staffing and 'Removed' with no date. The Peakbagging table lists 'Game Lake Peak (LO site)' with a 4,401 ft elevation and a 1989 date of unclear meaning; it was not used. The sources do not name a builder. The record's 'ground' kind is supported by the Oregon list's 'Ground' label, but firelookout.com's L-4 cab and cabin wording may suggest a small building rather than a tower; the editor may want to check the kind field. Corrections: none proposed.
